title: Credit Suisse Sandeep Khera Shares Insights on Shared Services and Outsourcing in Asia
description: INTERESTED IN LEARNING MORE ABOUT THIS TOPIC?  http://www.ssweekasia.com/  For more information contact us at [EMAIL] Phone: [PHONE]  Sandeep Khera, Chief Operating Officer, Credit Suisse Singapore  Sandeep Khera brings more than 20 years' experience in IT and Project Management; Financial Markets; IT Strategy and Applications Architecture; Solutions development and roll out; and consulting. As Chief Operating Officer for Asiapac IT, Sandeep manages financials and the regional budget, develops the overall IT APAC strategy, as well as IT Centers of Excellence strategy and oversees efficiency management for the region. In 2010, Sandeep mobilized a program to re-align and reposition the CoE organization including people and financials in an optimal and controlled manner and define a lean and effective structure for central CoE function to support the repositioned CoE program. He is managing the global CoE strategy including development and implementation. Likewise, building and maintaining relationships with all strategic vendors also fall under his remit. In the same year, Sandeep led an initiative to build and run Program Services and consulting practice in APAC IT within Credit Suisse. Notably, Sandeep was involved in setting up of the Centre of Excellence for Credit Suisse in Pune (India), which won the Forbes Applied Innovation Award for the work that he has contributed to the setting up of the Centre.
